build_habitat_sim_config: build a Habitat-Sim simulator configuration with scene ID, physics settings, and agent parameters using make_cfg
create_sensor_specs: create camera sensor specifications with resolution, position, orientation, and hfov from SIM config
configure_agent_actions: configure agent action space with move_forward, turn_left, and turn_right actions using ActuationSpec
add_depth_noise_model: add RedwoodDepthNoiseModel to the depth sensor when SIM.noisy is enabled
review_make_cfg: review the make_cfg function that builds SimulatorConfiguration with sensor specs and agent action space
